name: Death's Presence raises party/raid damage dealt
contract: Death's Presence 520371 promises party/raid members deal 3% more damage. Its single effect is native SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID (65) with EffectApplyAuraName SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE (79) and EffectBasePoints 2 + DieSides 1 = 3. #3724 read the aura as 'Mod School Immunity (79)' - that label does not match this repository's DBCStructure.h enum, where 79 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE, a completely standard raid buff aura with no CoA-specific handling. Both the area-aura target and the percent-damage aura are handled generically by the core spell/aura system.
